sentences.text: No, the documents do not permit adding penal interest to the loan rate for this case; they say penalty, if charged, shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’ that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.
The documents do not state a rate at which penal interest should be added, because they state that penal interest shall not be used in that form.

The older Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023) materials discuss penal interest / penal charges and say the quantum shall be reasonable, but those materials are superseded and do not provide a current add-on rate here.
